projects.title: Kaizen Project — Subassembly Relocation
projects.description: The objective of this Kaizen project was to identify and relocate moveable subassemblies off the main production line to improve operator efficiency and reinforce a lean manufacturing culture. The team measured the current footprint of existing subassembly stations and identified optimal future locations within the plant, reducing line congestion and supporting continuous flow.
projects.meta: Line C · Roseau, MN · March 2024 · A3 Sub Assembly Review

projects.title: The Time Machine — Automated Wake-Up System
projects.description: A self-designed embedded system built to solve a real personal problem: waking up to sound alone was never enough — light was always needed. The device mounts near a standard light switch and features a 4×4 keypad for setting a wake-up timer, a buzzer alarm, and a servo-actuated arm that physically flips the switch when the timer expires. A PIR motion sensor detects movement once the user is up and automatically resets the entire system.
projects.meta: C / C++ · Microcontroller · Laser-Cut Enclosure · PIR Sensor · Servo Actuator
